summary: Core & Main filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary Core Main LP proposed an amendment to its existing Term Loan Credit Agreement to incur a new $800 million senior term loan and potentially $750 million of senior unsecured debt to refinance $1.23 billion of outstanding borrowings due 2028 and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. The closing is subject to market conditions, with no guarantee of completion. There are no equity implications, premiums, or activist involvement. Watch for market conditions affecting execution.
